accounts.logout.consequence: %s is signed out on this machine; its token stays valid at its provider.

apps.remove.consequence: %s leaves this machine; its data stays.

background.remove.consequence: %s leaves this machine; its data stays.

disk.erase.consequence: The data of %s is deleted for good.

disk.free-unused.consequence: Deleted for good: %s. No machine and no file of yours is touched.

engine.stop.consequence: Every VM of this Mac stops, and nothing is shared until the engine starts again.

grants.remove.consequence: The grant of %s ends now; the password stays in this Mac's vault.

images.delete.consequence: %s is deleted; the next create that needs it builds it again.

machinefile.apply.consequence: %s leaves this machine; its data stays.

machines.cleanup.consequence: Every stopped ephemeral workspace is deleted.

machines.create-server.consequence: %s is built first, which takes several minutes.

machines.create-workspace.consequence: %s is built first, which takes several minutes.

machines.delete.consequence: %s and everything on its disk are deleted for good.

machines.forget.consequence: %s leaves your machines; nothing on it changes.

machines.restart.consequence: %s restarts: its VMs stop, and its servers start again once it is back.

server.consequence: It is a server: what it serves stops while it restarts.

workspace.consequence: %s stops, then starts again: what it serves stops while it restarts.

machines.restart-mac.consequence: %s restarts: its VMs stop, and its servers start again once it is back.

machines.stop.consequence: %s stops: what it serves stops until you start it again.

server.consequence: %s stops: what it serves stops until you start it again.

ports.stop-sharing.consequence: %s is no longer shared, and its reserved port is released.

ports.undeclare.consequence: %s is no longer declared, so a listener on it is flagged again.

settings.apply.consequence: Your value of %s is replaced by the one the file asks.

settings.off.consequence: station stops applying %s on this machine; its value now stays.

settings.run-containers.consequence: %s leaves this machine; its data stays.

setup.init.consequence: Moved where each app now looks, one rename each: %s.

vault.remove.consequence: %s leaves this Mac's vault, and every grant made from it ends.
